title: P2RLN Native Questionnaire Profile
description: Defines a portable, declarative questionnaire representation that a P2RLN Reading System can render and score without requiring a foreign runtime.
rules: The representation media type MUST be application/vnd.p2rln.questionnaire+json.
Question, choice, blank and matching identifiers are portable activity-internal identifiers and MUST NOT be installation-local database identifiers.
Learner answers, attempts, grades and persisted runtime state MUST NOT be embedded as questionnaire design state.
embedded-key grading is portable and offline-capable but does not provide answer-key secrecy because the key is delivered to the client.
host grading MAY omit embedded solutions; the runtime then emits answers but MUST NOT fabricate an authoritative score.
A Reading System MUST NOT claim delivery of a questionnaire containing timeLimitSeconds unless that runtime actually enforces the declared timing semantics.
Advanced assessment semantics for which QTI is authoritative SHOULD use the QTI profile rather than redefining QTI in this profile.
